title: #74 Stephen Penman: Financial Statement Analysis for Value Investing
summary:
Hello everyone and welcome to Investing by the Books, a podcast by Red Eye. I'm your host, Eddie Palmian and with me in the studio, this time is my friend and colleague,
Martin Volstrom, who is an analyst here at Red Eye. I'm happy to be back in sunny Stockholm after a nice vacation and I'm also
